# DERIVED WORK - NOT ORIGINAL. Generated by tools/aio6/aio6-layout.py from
# the Perfect Dark All in One 6.0 distribution (pd-aio-6.0), for the fojo
# modloader. It carries the 196 C*/G* models the generated HeadsAndBodies roster below references, the 719 textures every pack ships identically, and the 3 sequences.
#
# Left out of this mod: 40 C*/G* files held back (listed at the end of this file); every level file (see the mod_aio6_* stage mods).
#
# Every credit and revision-history line from the source modconfig(s) is
# reproduced below unaltered. The level, model and texture work is the
# original authors'.
# ==========================================================================

# ==========================================================================
# HeadsAndBodies, generated from jonaeru/perfect_dark @ port-mods/all-in-one
# (src/game/modeldata/robot.c g_HeadsAndBodies[], src/game/mplayer/mplayer.c
# g_MpHeads[] / g_MpBodies[], port/src/romdata.c expansionFiles[]). Entry
# names are AIO's own FILE_ identifiers; `label` is the body's display name
# as the AIO LoptionsE/LmpmenuE banks spell it. `label` is NOT read by the
# loader yet - HeadsAndBodies has only the numeric `bodyname` lang id, and
# AIO's ids point at vanilla slots it overwrote (e.g. L_OPTIONS_211 is
# "Subtitles" in vanilla, "Bond (Arctic)" in AIO), so those ids are not
# emitted. Until `label` lands these bodies render langGet(0) as their name
# (g_MpBodies[].name is left at 0 by the loader).
# ==========================================================================
